How to add speech:
1. Create a new costume.
2. Name it with a unique speech title.
3. Draw your speech bubble and text inside the costume.
4. If you want multiple pages in the speech, create a new costume for each page.
5. To end the speech, put "_" at the beginning of the costume name for the last page in the speech. (Look at the costumes for examples!)

How to make the speech show up in the game:
1. Determine the (camera x, camera y) coordinates where you want it to show up.
2. Fill out an "add_location" custom block using the speech title and (camera x, camera y) coordinates.
3. Add the block to the "init" custom block stack below.
4. Done!
